meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 获取主机可用资源快照，辅助运行前判断
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你常跑吃资源的大任务，想知道本机是否扛得住。
copy.tagline_en: Get a snapshot of your machine's available resources before launching a task.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often run resource-heavy tasks and want to know whether your machine can handle them.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在计算密集型任务开始前运行检测脚本,在当前目录生成 .claude_resources.json,里面写明 CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘情况和并行、内存、GPU 的策略建议。
howto.when: 当你要求做计算密集的科研任务时触发,例如分析大数据集、训练模型、并行处理文件等;原文也建议在项目初始化时主动调用。

say.text: 先检测这台机器的资源,再决定这个 50GB 数据集怎么处理
say.note: 会先跑检测脚本再给方案

say.text: 看看有没有可用 GPU,决定模型训练用哪个后端
确认内存和磁盘够不够,再决定并行开几个 worker
say.note: 会按核心数给出建议 worker 数

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude runs a detection script before compute-heavy tasks and writes .claude_resources.json with CPU, GPU, memory, and disk details plus parallel, memory, and GPU strategy suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered before computationally intensive scientific work such as data analysis, model training, or parallel processing; it can also be run at project initialization.

say_en.text: Check this machine's resources first, then decide how to handle a 50GB dataset
See if a GPU is available and which backend to use for training
Confirm memory and disk are enough, then pick a worker count
say_en.note: Suggests workers based on core count
